items.exampleEn: The hero in the story kept his oath until the very end.

items.sentenceEn: In court, every witness must take an oath to tell the truth.

items.audioEn: The price of a parking space downtown is outrageous, so I'll take the bus instead.
items.audioZh: 市中心的停車費高得離譜，所以我改搭公車。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼要改搭公車？
options: The bus is faster in the city
The car is in the repair shop

items.sentenceEn: He spoke proudly about his daughter's success at university.
items.sentenceZh: 他驕傲地談起女兒在大學的成就。

items.sentenceEn: The movie's ending was so moving that I couldn't speak.
items.sentenceZh: 電影的結局太感人了，我說不出話來。

items.stemEn: After a ____ workout at the gym, I always feel full of energy.
items.stemZh: 在健身房做完一場高強度的訓練後，我總是覺得精力充沛。

items.stemEn: She showed nothing but ____ for people who tell lies.
items.stemZh: 她對說謊的人只有鄙視。

items.passageEn: Our small town's football team had humble beginnings: twenty years ago, the players trained on a field full of stones. Last season, however, they had improved considerably, played aggressively, and reached the national final. Some fans of the other team treated them with contempt, calling them a team of beginners. The players answered with vigorous training and a calm attitude. In a moving speech before the game, the captain reminded everyone of their oath to always play fair. They lost by one goal, but the whole town proudly welcomed them home. Even the final's ticket prices, which many people called outrageous, did not stop hundreds of fans from traveling to watch.
items.passageZh: 我們小鎮的足球隊起步很卑微：二十年前，球員們在一片滿是石頭的場地上練習。不過上個球季，他們進步了很多，打法積極，一路打進全國決賽。對方的一些球迷很瞧不起他們，叫他們新手隊。球員們用高強度的訓練和冷靜的態度回應。賽前，隊長發表了一段感人的演說，提醒大家他們曾宣誓永遠公平比賽。他們以一球之差落敗，但全鎮的人都驕傲地歡迎他們回家。就連決賽那被許多人稱為離譜的票價，也擋不住數百名球迷遠道去觀賽。

questions.questionZh: 二十年前，球員們在哪裡練習？
options: 一片滿是石頭的練習場地
鎮上小學的室內體育館
延長賽後雙方打成平手

items.promptZh: 那家公司正積極地推銷它的新產品。
referenceEn: That company is aggressively selling its new product.
The company has been aggressively promoting its new products.
rubricZh: aggressively 修飾動詞（例如 aggressively selling、aggressively promoting）
「正…」可用現在進行式或現在完成進行式

items.promptZh: 雖然他很有名，他仍然很謙虛。
referenceEn: Although he is famous, he is still very humble.
He is famous, but he remains humble.
rubricZh: humble 是形容詞，表示「謙遜的」（例如 is very humble、remains humble 等）
「雖然」可寫，例如 although、but 等（不要同時用 although 和 but）
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 is、was 等）
